_readme: Placeholder copy for all 45 built slides. Internal is a regional field-services programme moving three branches onto one service desk. External is a maintenance and modernisation proposal for a mixed-use portfolio. Every figure is round and evidently illustrative. Icon names are real names from assets/icon-names.txt; external slots are left empty on purpose, because no external layout names an icon. Slots typed as strings that are semantically lists carry one clause — see NOTES.md, contract problem 1.
